verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
LEERO azuukidde
-Omulimu guwedde,
Abasibe bateereddwa,
-Okufa kuwanguddwa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu azuukidde
Entaana njereere
Abaagulibwa bawonye
Balifuga naye.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Yesu azuukidde
Mulamu takyafa,
Anaatuwolerezanga
Emirembe gyonna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Yesu azuukide
Mwenna musanyuke
Mweyonger-okujaguza
Kubanga azuukidde.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
-Abakubi b'ennanga
N'abayimbi bonna
Muyimbe mwenna n'essanyu
Yesu azuukidde
